name: StrengthAnalysis.RectSection.RectStressBlock
comment: Returns the ultimate moment and axial force of a rectangular section under a rectangular stress block. Arguments: sectionH, sectionB, fcd, εcu, Ec, rebarAreaArr, rebarDepthArr, fyd, Es, λ, neutralAxisDepth, isSaggingCapacity. Section and rebar depths are in mm, areas in mm2, stresses and moduli in MPa, strains dimensionless. Depths are from the top. Sagging compression is at the top. Hogging measures depths from the bottom and returns a negative moment. The stress-block depth is MIN(λ*neutralAxisDepth, sectionH). Steel stress is Es times strain, limited to ±fyd. Moment is about the transformed centroid and is in kNm. Axial force is in kN, compression positive. The result is a 1×2 row, moment then axial. A neutral-axis depth of 0 returns #DIV/0!. Text returns #VALUE!. Last Update at 2026-11-03.
